start.message:
Hello! This is Izoh ✨

A simple way to listen to guests: reviews, complaints, and suggestions come straight to Telegram.

Open the app, create your place, and get a QR code for guests.

groupConnect.success:
Done, I'm in touch ✨

Notifications for "{{organizationName}}" will now be sent to this group.
If a guest leaves a review, complaint or suggestion, I will carefully post it here.
groupConnect.errorOwner: This group must be selected by the place owner.
groupConnect.errorInvalid: Failed to connect the group. Open notifications and select the group again.
